facts.fact: Newsmada reports that a UNDP tender this year covers servers and computers for CENI's management of biometric data, and that CENI received USD 750,000 of Japan-UNDP IT equipment on 23 October 2026 in preparation for a biometric voter list; the current overhaul still runs on an alphanumeric system, with over 7.16 million registered against a 14 million target.

MDG.note: Civic education radio support only; no online consultation stated.
